ConnectionStrings._comment: Supavisor transaction-mode pooler (port 6543) for app runtime traffic; use session mode (5432) only for `dotnet ef database update`. Max Auto Prepare=0/No Reset On Close=true are required in transaction mode — Npgsql's prepared-statement cache assumes one physical backend per logical connection, which the pooler doesn't guarantee, and skipping this surfaces as random stream-read timeouts.
ConnectionStrings.Default: Host=aws-0-eu-west-1.pooler.supabase.com;Port=6543;Database=postgres;Username=postgres.<project-ref>;Password=<use-user-secrets>;SSL Mode=Require;Trust Server Certificate=true;Pooling=true;Max Auto Prepare=0;No Reset On Close=true

Supabase._comment: No JwtSecret here — access tokens use Supabase's rotatable asymmetric signing keys, verified via {Url}/auth/v1/.well-known/jwks.json (see AddSupabaseAuthentication), not a static secret.
